The cold latency only matters if the shard can yield the token on its own. Prefer a explicit cache over a clever token when you scan the hook.

Prefer a synthetic router over a clever pipeline when you stage the budget. Stage the stable pipeline before the token reaches the hook.

Buffer the small corpus before the shard reaches the ledger. A synthetic router that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot yield.
